entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, some of the guys in[n]my class have been talking.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: About that Suzui girl...[n]Looks like rumors are going[n]around about her and Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If they're true, it's no wonder[n]I couldn't get her to talk.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still, something about that[n]doesn't seem right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's nothing so clear cut, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've known Takamaki and Suzui[n]since middle school.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's just no way Kamoshida's[n]their type, y'know?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... I gotta wonder where[n]those rumors came from.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess we'll get to it[n]tomorrow. See ya!
